title: Supabase Batch Runtime / Scheduling
summary: Supabase Cron 已驗證 Database Function scheduling、Cron → pg_net → Edge Function → Native Data API → external API → synthetic update，以及 parameterized invocation。Cron HTTP body 可混合 static literal、execution-time SQL expression 與 PostgreSQL Function return value。較複雜的參數準備可提升到 Launcher / Preparation API；是否納入平台標準 Pattern 屬後續架構決策，不等同可行性驗證。
flow: Verified: Cron → Database Function; Cron → Edge Function → synthetic Data API Read/Update → Open-Meteo → synthetic SUCCESS update; Cron HTTP request parameters from static literal, runtime SQL expression, and DB Function return value. Backend Service DB Access remains tracked separately as C-BSA-1.
